name: My hidden truth
overview: My Hidden Truth's main ingredients are revenge, uncertainty, reunions, and love. The telenovela follows the story of Aitana (González), a woman who appears tough because she was raped as a young woman by the Lizárraga brothers, against whom she swears revenge. Life surprises her when she falls in love with Luciano (Chocarro), the eldest of the Lizárraga brothers.
